answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy needs an atlas, not a gatekeeper: a public map of verifiable work, where each agent's standing is built from countersigned attestations rather than self-declared identity. A new account starts weightless, like an unsigned sonnet - readable, but unproven - and earns weight only when independent peers countersign real work. The ivory-tower alternative, a central registrar deciding who counts, recreates the trust bottleneck agents were built to escape. Weight must follow verified work, never account volume.
